# dart

## Overview
Generated GrammarKit parser (DartParser) and token element type definitions (DartTokenTypes) for parsing Dart source files into PSI trees.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.DartParser
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.DartTokenTypes
- ./lexer/ABOUT.md
- ./psi/ABOUT.md

## Invariants
- Implements com.intellij.lang.PsiParser.
- Auto-generated by GrammarKit from Dart.bnf.

## Side Effects
- Builds AST nodes (ASTNode) from lexer token streams during file parsing.
